connector.name: mcp-belgium
connector.registryDescription: Single MCP server for Belgian public transport, statistics, open data, and geospatial services.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-belgium. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lacausecrypto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
